profile_text.body:
Sketch is a for-profit design software company founded in 2010 and headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands. Its primary product is a macOS-native vector design tool built around an infinite canvas, and the company describes itself as focused on designers rather than project managers, developers, or clients. The tool supports designing, prototyping, collaborating, and handing off work to developers, and recent updates have added features including Oklab and Oklch gradients and an improved prototype player.

The company tracks an AI product called Sketch AI, categorized under image and graphic design, which offers local processing as an option and is associated with EU design data handling. Sketch describes itself as an independent company and emphasizes privacy and pricing decisions made on its own terms rather than under outside pressure.

The site's held facts include a registered MCP server entry under the name app.roughsketch/roughsketch, described as enabling users to search, read, preview, create, update, rename, arrange, and trash sketches in Google Drive. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
